text_block_list.text:
Our third-year summer camp comes to
an end.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: You'll be late for the bus, you know.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Looks like I better get going! I'll see you
for more
top-notch training when we're
back at the
academy, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Ever boisterous and ready for more,
Winning
Ticket joins Бива Хаяхидэ and
Нарита Таисин on
the bus.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: (I'm glad they managed to make up.)

text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is the Arima Kinen. It's
time to get
pumped so we really can
make it the best race
ever!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
